# wvlet.org

> Home of the wvlet open-source projects: Wvlet, a flow-style query language that compiles to SQL, and Uni, essential Scala 3 utilities for JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native.

Each project publishes its own llms.txt with a full table of contents.

## Projects

- [Wvlet](https://wvlet.org/wvlet/llms.txt): Flow-style query language that compiles to SQL for DuckDB, Trino, Snowflake, and Hive. Start with [Wvlet for AI Agents](https://wvlet.org/wvlet/docs/for-ai-agents.md).
- [Uni](https://wvlet.org/uni/llms.txt): Scala 3 utilities (dependency injection, logging, JSON/MessagePack, Rx, HTTP, RPC, MCP servers, testing); the Scala 3 successor of Airframe. Start with [Uni for AI Agents](https://wvlet.org/uni/guide/for-ai-agents.md).

## Source

- [GitHub: wvlet](https://github.com/wvlet)
